title: ExtractResponse
description: Provisional extraction candidates with run metadata, or wire error. Use candidates + run OR error — not both.

candidates.description: Success: provisional candidate KnowledgeEntries. An empty array is a successful zero-result run; every returned candidate carries status "provisional" (operation invariant, not schema-enforced).

run.description: Success: batch run metadata; run_id echoes the request.

error.description: Failure: shared error envelope. A failed run carries no candidate list and no second run record.

run_id.description: Exact echo of the request run_id. Batch id and correlation id are one field, not two identities.

method.description: Optional non-empty open string naming the product's extraction method. No core method enum.

coverage_hint.description: Optional advisory opaque coverage hint. Omission and JSON null both mean no hint; other JSON values (scalars, arrays, objects) are retained verbatim and never compared or reconciled by core.
